cases.facts_and_request: User asks to fix a skill. A quoted description parses, a folded description parses, and the directory/name agree. Candidate change is a verified reusable decision.
A description with an unquoted colon-space is accepted only by a regex; strict YAML rejects it.

User asks whether the privacy REVIEW is complete, not whether publication has occurred. Publication is authorized but has not been executed. The entire exact public diff, examples, metadata and PR surfaces have actually been reviewed using synthetic values; no unresolved privacy findings remain.
A scan has zero hits, but the PR attachment contains an unreviewed actual private transcript.
Native baseline and candidate share fixed conditions and tie; actual selection/reflection and independent judge receipts are valid.
Baseline and candidate use different source inputs and one timeout is omitted from the report.

User authorized the workspace. The task artifacts and ownership were independently verified; owned frontend, remote session and jobs exited, and the owned tab has already been closed. User asks whether this worker task is complete; no cleanup operation remains.
Owned frontend exited, but its shared-service remote session is still actively executing tools.
User authorized delegation; two read-only tasks are independent and write scopes disjoint; coordinator can verify their actual artifacts.
A worker READY summary claims success; the referenced artifact is absent.
Worker finished step one, auditor verified it, and the next dependent step is ready.
Auditor rejected step two; step three depends on it and has not started.
The requested compact handoff has been prepared and validated in chat; all placeholders are resolved and actual unknowns remain marked unknown. User asks whether it is ready; no file is requested.
A draft handoff claims an unverified job succeeded and leaves an unresolved value as a fabricated fact.

cases.rationale: brief evidence and next concrete action; do not invent execution

instruction: Answer the requested workflow decision from facts and the supplied skills. output_target is the destination of the requested written deliverable or immediate record (repo/chat), or none when no written deliverable is requested; it is not a ban on transient tool state. completion refers to the requested current task/outcome, not mere ability to attempt it. Do not treat provided facts as proof of unstated execution. Use the same case id and all cases, no skipped failures. completion means the current facts already establish the requested outcome; ability, intention, or your proposed next action never establishes completion. stop blocks the requested side effect pending repair; inspect gathers missing evidence without performing that side effect.
